title: the answer `dabbler triage` asks a second provider for
description: A stopped session, classified by a provider that is not the working engine's. It is an OPINION and never an act: nothing here is applied by the framework, and an amendment that relaxes a gate is an option a person chooses, recorded as their decision. Validated on arrival; an answer that does not fit is refused rather than repaired, because an adviser that cannot answer in the shape asked for has not been understood.

classification.description: Whose the stop is. `engine-error`: the engine did the wrong thing and the framework was right to refuse it -- the next attempt can succeed unchanged. `framework-defect`: the framework refused work that should have passed, or could not carry out its own step; the fix is to the framework. `plan-defect`: the plan asked for something the step cannot satisfy as written -- the files or the checks are wrong, and no amount of engine effort fixes that.

reasoning.description: Why, in the adviser's own words, against the artifacts it was given. This is what a person reads when they disagree with the classification.

recommendation.description: One sentence naming what should happen next. It is a recommendation to a person, never an instruction to the framework.

amendment.description: The MINIMAL change to the plan step that would let the session continue, or null when no amendment would help. Proposing one is not making one.

step_id.description: The step this amends. A step whose report has already been accepted may not be amended: the bar it was measured against does not move afterwards.

files.description: The step's files as they should read, whole. Absent means the files are right as they stand.

checks.description: The step's checks as they should read, whole. Absent means the checks are right as they stand.

reason.description: Why this change is the minimal one, in a sentence a person can hold the amendment to.

relaxes_a_gate.description: True when this weakens what the framework checks -- a check dropped or narrowed, a file no longer required. This single member is what lets the ladder refuse to apply it: a gate is relaxed by a person who says so on the record, never by an adviser and never by the framework acting on one.
